name: io.github.2ez4gcx/autocad-mcp
title: AutoCAD MCP
description: Let AI draw in AutoCAD: plans from images, KT/KC/NT sets, TCVN calc, quantities, sheets, PDF.

environmentVariables.name: AUTOCAD_MCP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: TCP port of the ACAD MCP Bridge add-in in AutoCAD (type MCPPORT in AutoCAD to change it there too)

environmentVariables.name: AUTOCAD_MCP_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Seconds to wait for AutoCAD to answer one command
